info.name: ProductInventory - Retail and Wholesale Test Data
info.description:
Demo copy for the ODA Canvas authentication video: the RedBrand PermissionSpecificationSet is named CSP (the CSP's role). Everything else is unchanged from reference-example-components @ be11fd0 source/ProductInventory/tests/RetailandWholesale. Use that folder's Cleanup collection to remove the data.

Creates sample Vodafone RedBrand and MVNO PermissionSpecificationSets in a Product Inventory Management v4 (pi1) component instance. Requests must be run in order.
